From your first question to your first setup. Find the answer you came for, without the runaround.

The short answer

IPTV is television delivered over an internet connection. A compatible device, a player and an authorised content source work together. Plans, channel availability and device limits vary by provider.

15 answers

Getting started

What is IPTV?

IPTV means Internet Protocol Television: television delivered through an internet connection instead of a satellite dish or traditional cable connection. You need a compatible device, a player and an active subscription from a provider with rights to distribute the content.

Which Lumina Stream plan should I choose?

Choose Duck, Edge, Raccoon or Trex for live TV, movies and series, or Ciné Pack for on-demand viewing. Select a term of 1, 3, 6 or 12 months and one, two or three simultaneous streams. All plan totals are shown in CAD.

Can I check a specific channel before choosing a plan?

Yes. Use the channel request tool to build a list of the channels, languages or programmes that matter to you. Confirm the exact lineup available in Canada for your selected plan before paying. List the English, French or other feeds that matter to you.

Plans & billing

What currency are the prices in?

All prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD). Each card shows the total for the selected term and the equivalent monthly cost. Applicable taxes, final prices and any other charges must be disclosed before a live payment is accepted.

Will my subscription renew automatically?

Plans are prepaid for the chosen term. There is no automatic renewal.

How many screens can I watch at once?

Choose one, two or three simultaneous streams. Prices vary by server, term and stream count; the plan cards and checkout use the same price table. Household rules and actual service availability must be confirmed before purchase.

How does the 24-hour trial work?

The trial costs CAD 2.99, lasts 24 hours and covers one stream. Use it to check your device, connection and requested channels before choosing a longer subscription.

Devices & setup

Can I use the TV I already own?

Possibly. Compatibility depends on your TV model, operating system, regional app store and the player supported by the service. Check the device guide before ordering. A compatible streaming device connected by HDMI may be an alternative.

Does an IPTV player include a subscription?

No. A player is software that plays a stream or playlist. Content access is separate, and some players charge their own fee. Only enter credentials issued by your authorised service provider.

What do I need before setup?

Have your device model, a stable internet connection, a compatible player and the connection details supplied by your provider ready. Install software from the official app store or developer source. Keep account credentials private.

Streaming & support

Why does a stream buffer?

Buffering can come from a weak Wi-Fi signal, network congestion, device limitations or the content source. First compare another app on the same device, restart the player, try Ethernet where available and test a lower playback quality. If only one channel fails, tell support which channel and when it happened.

Is 4K available on every channel?

No. Picture quality depends on the source, your plan, device, player, display and network. A 4K-capable television cannot turn every source into native 4K. Confirm the resolution of the channels you care about before buying.

What should I include in a support request?

Share your device model, player name, a description of the issue, the affected channel or title, and when it happened. Never put your password, full playlist URL or payment information in a public message.

Trust & availability

How can I check a provider’s content permissions?

Ask the provider which content it is authorised to distribute and in which countries. Confirm the business identity, service terms, refund policy and payment route before purchasing. A large channel count alone does not establish that a provider has permission to distribute the content.

Can I watch while travelling?

Country restrictions and account rules may limit access when you travel. Check the permitted territory and household rules before relying on the service outside your usual location. A VPN does not change the provider’s distribution rights.
